notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.12
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm![/b] 
[/p][p]Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.12 is now live on Steam!   [/p][p][/p][p]This is a Hotfix that includes a major fix for the Start Screen bug. We apologise for the inconvenience this bug caused to some users. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.12 - Change List --[/b]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The game will no longer crash / close after Pressing Any Key to Start and the screen fading to black.[/p][/*][*][p]The Arcane 2 Spell: Mage Shield should no longer block the players arrows. [/p][p]  [/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-) [/p]

tags.bug: The game will no longer crash / close after Pressing Any Key to Start and the screen fading to black.
The Arcane 2 Spell: Mage Shield should no longer block the players arrows.

notes.title: Mythrealm Demo - Hotfix - Version 1.11
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings adventurers into the Mythrealm![/b] 
[/p][p]Mythrealm Game Demo Version 1.11 is now live on Steam!  
[/p][p]This is a Hotfix that includes a few  bug fixes.  
[/p][p][b]-- Mythrealm Game Demo V1.11 - Change List --[/b]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Tumble (Dodge Roll) Keyboard Binding can now be remapped in the Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fairy NPC Vendor in Level 01 can now be interacted with using a Gamepad / Controller. [/p][/*][*][p]A "Click the Text to Continue..." message has been added to Vendor Dialogue to make it more clear how to proceed in the conversation with the NPC. [/p][/*][*][p]A bugged rock in the level 01 climbing shaft has been fixed. 
 [/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to work on fixing any bugs we find or players report. Thanks for playing Mythrealm!   

Happy adventuring! :-) [/p]

tags.feature: The Tumble (Dodge Roll) Keyboard Binding can now be remapped in the Settings.
The Fairy NPC Vendor in Level 01 can now be interacted with using a Gamepad / Controller.
A "Click the Text to Continue..." message has been added to Vendor Dialogue to make it more clear how to proceed in the conversation with the NPC.

tags.bug: A bugged rock in the level 01 climbing shaft has been fixed.
